what.name: Study
what.value_plain: WaveTrend (LazyBear): cross out of the overbought / oversold band, BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT: BTC / USDT, 1 hour WaveTrend: long when WT1 crosses up through WT2 below -53; short on a down-cross above +53; market entry at the next bar, stop past the last 3 bars, exit on a target at 1.5 x risk or after 100 bars; fees 0.02 % limit / 0.05 % market, plus 0.02 % slippage on market and stop fills; 2023-03-01 to 2023-05-31.
what.label: OURS

how: Run on the local simulator desk: the study re-simulates every idea on development data; the optional condition then keeps only matching trades (post-filter on the cached run). Fees are included; a never-filled idea is not a trade.
window: DEV only, 2023-03-01 to 2023-05-31 (VALIDATION and HOLDOUT never offered)
why: 95 % range of the average -0.401 to +0.282 R: too wide to call either way; 50 trades can only rule out edges above about +0.51 R

examples.title: Running total of net R, filled trades in time order
